decisions.about: IAM handwriting database as training data (non-commercial research only)
decisions.decision: Never train or fine-tune on IAM for the sold product.
Do not make it mandatory: an ObjectStore interface (SW-S6) - cloud storage when hosted; an encrypted filesystem store or the customer's S3-compatible store when installed.
found: src/cdi_adapter/storage.py: the only store is the S3 client (any S3 service works; there is no filesystem store)
decisions.status: OPEN - NEEDS AN OWNER AND A DATE

decisions.about: Redis server (BSD-3 up to 7.2; RSALv2 / SSPLv1 from 7.4)
decisions.decision: Pin 7.2 or older, or switch to Valkey. No upgrade to 7.4 or later without a compliance review.
Do not bundle. Expose Prometheus / OpenTelemetry metrics; customers attach their own.
